clue.text: Appeals for guidance in addition

indicators.note: one thing sitting in another means it goes inside, so the first word's letters are placed within the second's

blocks.note: a postscript, abbreviated PS, is an addition at the end of a letter
to give a lead is to give guidance

explanation.surface: Someone sends extra requests for advice.
explanation.walkthrough: PS is the usual crossword abbreviation for an addition to a letter; LEAD goes inside it to give PLEADS.
explanation.definitionFit: To plead is to make an earnest request, so pleads works as the verb appeals.

clue.text: Allowed no credit - that can slow things down

explanation.surface: A refusal to extend credit puts the brakes on spending.
explanation.walkthrough: Lending and credit look like one money idea, but LENT and O are separate pieces. Lento is the musical marking for a slow tempo.
explanation.definitionFit: Lento is the Italian tempo direction telling players to perform slowly, so it slows the music down.

explanation.definitionFit: An apologist is a person who argues in defence of a cause or doctrine, so he defends it.

clue.text: Dispute over quarters in short supply

blocks.note: to spar is to argue or dispute
two quarters of the compass, south and east

explanation.surface: An argument about accommodation when housing is scarce.

explanation.definitionFit: Sparse means thinly scattered or scanty, the state of something available only in small amounts.

clue.text: Unsettled individual making complaint about a bad turn

explanation.definitionFit: A gadabout is a person who restlessly roams from place to place seeking amusement, never settling anywhere.

clue.text: He carved a fish and an animal into beams

explanation.definitionFit: Grinling Gibbons was a celebrated English sculptor in wood, so he is the one who carved.

clue.text: Having the same natural gift

explanation.definitionFit: A donative is a gift or donation, especially an official one, so the noun means a present.

explanation.definitionFit: The bison is a large wild ox of North America and Europe, a beast in the old sense of a large animal.

clue.text: She'll take no more than two halves of mild

explanation.definitionFit: Mimi is a woman's name, most famously the seamstress heroine of La Boheme, so she fits the pronoun.

clue.text: Tense, being poor
